question.text: A stone tied to a string is rotated in a vertical circle. The minimum speed of the stone during a complete vertical circular motion

options.text: is independent of the mass of the stone
is independent of the length of the string
decreases with increasing mass of the stone
decreases with increasing length of the string

solution.text:
Minimum speed with which the string is rotating in a vertical circle, (v) = gr

i.e, the minimum speed of stone is independent of the mass of stone.
